title: fix(plugin-form): merge `object-form.customFields` over the metadata-generated field set
body:
Fixes #9778

Clause-②: no

`object-form.customFields` now MERGES over the metadata-generated field set, per the director-seat ruling on the card (batch #161 item 5, summon #24, maintainer 「其他同意」 2026-09-18T12:07Z). The registration description is the contract and is **unchanged**.

Clause-② tested against this diff, not inherited: the diff adds **0** lines containing `export ` (lit control on the same corpus: 18 added lines contain `customFields`) and no new key on any published payload — an existing branch is made reachable. Answer stands at `no`.

## What changed

`ObjectForm.tsx`, three sites:

1. **The replace path is gone.** A non-empty `customFields` used to run `setFormFields(schema.customFields.map(normalizeVisibility))` and return above the metadata branch, so the object's schema was never even fetched.
2. **The metadata is now fetched whenever an `objectName` and a data source are present**, inline members or not — without the generated set there is nothing to merge over, and the merge lookup `schema.customFields?.find((f) => f.name === name)` stays the dead code objectui#8071 measured. The members-only schema (an object with no fields) became the **fallback** rather than the inline path's fixed answer: it is what the registration's second sentence describes, "with inline definitions and no data source, this becomes the only field source".
3. **Members naming nothing in the generated set are appended** after it, in authored order, right before `setFormFields(generatedFields)`.

Two smaller consequences, both deliberate:

- The loading flag no longer drops unconditionally on the inline path — it drops when nothing is going to be fetched, otherwise the metadata branch's own `willFetchData` tail clears it. Without this an empty `form` sat on screen for the duration of `getObjectSchema`.
- A `getObjectSchema` that throws (or returns nothing) now falls back to the members-only source **when inline members are present**, instead of replacing a form that used to render with an error panel. The metadata is an overlay on this path, not a prerequisite.

## The pins, one row per direction

`objectFormCustomFieldsMembers-8071.test.tsx` flips from pinning the replace behaviour to pinning the merge:

| row | direction | asserts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | shape + merge | members are whole field definitions keyed by `name`; the merged set is `customer, note, amount, zz` |
| 2 | **override** | a member takes the declared field's position, supplies its whole definition, **and the metadata IS fetched** — `getObjectSchema` inverted from `toBe(0)` to `toBe(1)` |
| 3 | **keep** | `customer` / `amount`, which no member names, still render with the object's own labels |
| 4 | **append** | members naming nothing declared come after the generated set, in authored order |
| 5 | (unchanged) | an EMPTY `customFields` is UNAUTHORED — the read is `.length > 0`, not truthiness |
| 6 | (unchanged) | the same member count exempts the block from the no-adapter panel; doubles as the control for the no-data-source sentence |

One collateral red, repaired in place and called out here: `ObjectForm.mobileFullscreen.test.tsx`'s "commits a fullscreen edit back into the form state" mounts a `customFields` member named `summary` against an object that also declares `changelog`, so the merge draws two expand affordances and an unscoped `findByTestId` found both. The lookup is now scoped to the field the case is about; nothing else in the file moved.

## Reverse verification (ablation)

The fix was committed first, then `ObjectForm.tsx` alone was reverted to this branch's base commit and the flipped pins re-run:

- mutation landed on disk: the `objectui#9778` markers went 5 to 0 and the replace path `setFormFields(schema.customFields.map(normalizeVisibility))` came back (1 occurrence); blob `85d6c1c4` against HEAD's `cd4bd869`
- result: **4 failed | 2 passed (6)** — rows 1-4 red, each for its own reason (`expected [ 'zz', 'note' ] to deeply equal [ 'customer', 'note', 'amount', 'zz' ]`; `expected +0 to be 1`; `expected null to be 'Customer'`; `expected [ 'zz', 'yy' ] to deeply equal [ 'customer', 'note', 'amount', …(2) ]`), rows 5-6 green as they should be, since neither is about the merge
- restored by `git checkout HEAD -- ObjectForm.tsx` (trap-guarded, absolute path): blob back to `cd4bd869`, `git diff HEAD` empty, markers back to 5

## Tests

Run at `096496e052`:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form test` — **100 files passed, 940 passed | 1 skipped (941)**
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` — exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`), after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build` — without that dependency-closure build it reports `TS2307 Cannot find module '@object-ui/*'` on every workspace import, which is a missing `dist`, not a type error
- consumers that pass `customFields` through: `packages/plugin-view/` + `packages/plugin-designer/` + `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` + `public-block-binding-reach.test.tsx` — **66 files, 757 passed**. The fenced ledger's counts do not move, exactly as the dispatch predicted, so it was **not edited**.
- gates, each exit code captured before any pipe: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` — all exit 0. `eslint` on the three changed files: 0 errors (64 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings).
- `check:sdui-registration-pins` — **NOT MEASURED**: exit 2 is its own prerequisite refusal ("No console build to weigh at apps/console/dist/assets"), not a red. This diff adds and removes no registration; CI builds the console and runs it.

## Acceptance notes

Out-of-scope findings, neither touched here:

1. **To file (class b).** The same registered description still describes the drawer and modal presentations of this block, and both still replace. `ObjectForm` spreads the schema — `customFields` included — into `DrawerForm` / `ModalForm` for `formType: 'drawer' | 'modal'`, and each of those runs its own `if (schema.customFields?.length) { setFormFields(schema.customFields); }`. So an author who takes the registration at its word gets a merge on the flat presentation and a replacement on the other two, from one declared key. Out of this card's file surface (the ruling names `ObjectForm.tsx`) and it needs its own pins. Dedupe words: `DrawerForm customFields replace` · `ModalForm customFields replace` · `presentation arms merge parity` · `formType drawer inline fields` · `customFields merge unreachable`.
2. **Noted, not filed.** The console ledger entry for `object-form.customFields` still describes the replace behaviour in prose ("they REPLACE the metadata-generated set … `getObjectSchema` asserted at zero calls … handed back as a finding rather than repaired"). It is reviewed prose, not a computed assertion — its counts do not move and its test stays green (measured above) — and the file is held by open PR objectui#9924, so it was not edited. Successor: whoever lands objectui#9924, or the next objectui#8071 slice that edits that ledger.
